programme.title: Girls in Bands at the BBC
programme.desc: Compilation celebrating some guitar band performances at the BBC that feature some of the best female musicians in rock. Beginning with the oft-forgotten American group Fanny performing You're the One, it's a journey along rock's spectrum from the 1970s to now. The selection includes the powerful vocals of Elkie Brooks on Vinegar Joe's Proud to Be a Honky Woman, the mesmerising poetry of Patti Smith's Horses and the upbeat energy of The Go-Go's on We Got the Beat. Mighty basslines come courtesy of Tina Weymouth on Psycho Killer and Kim Gordon on Sugar Kane, whilst we trace the line of indie rock from the Au Pairs through Lush, Elastica and Garbage to current band Savages.

programme.title: Wild
programme.desc: Documentary presenting an intimate portrait of one of Britain's most charming wild animals, following a family of water voles living on a canal in Derbyshire though a typical year. The picturesque Cromford canal used to serve the region's cotton mills. Now, having been deserted, it serves as a perfect water vole paradise. For these hyperactive little mammals, a year is nearly a lifetime. They spend their lives in a frenzy of activity - swimming, feeding and breeding - the latter of most necessity, since water voles are becoming a rarity.

programme.title: Full Circle with Michael Palin
programme.desc: Michael Palin circles the Pacific Rim through 18 countries. After a journey on a rusty ferry through the dangerous Sulu Sea, he arrives in Borneo at monsoon time. From the rainforest, he heads off to the long houses of the Iban tribesmen and the secret heart of Borneo. Across the equator in Java, the most densely populated island in the world, he visits the largest monument in the southern hemisphere.

programme.title: Miss Marple

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Treasures

programme.title: Ran
programme.desc: Akira Kurosawa's epic masterpiece is a reworking of Shakespeare's King Lear set in medieval Japan. After a lifetime of battles, 70-year-old Lord Hidetora announces that he is passing his authority to his eldest son Taro. The youngest son Saburo protests and is banished from the kingdom. But instead of fulfilling their father's wishes, Taro and middle brother Jiro are disloyal to the former lord and attack his castle. Hidetora survives but following his sons' betrayal is now losing his mind. When Jiro has his brother murdered, the banished Saburo and his allies return to fight a battle against the remaining brother. In Japanese with English subtitles.

programme.desc: Documentary in which Andrew Graham-Dixon reveals how the Medici family transformed Florence through sculpture, painting and architecture, and created a world where masterpieces fetch millions today. programme.desc: Three-part series that looks at a year in Alaska, revealing the stories of pioneering Alaskans, both animal and human, as they battle the elements and reap the benefits of nature's seasonal gold rush.

programme.title: The Story of Scottish Art
programme.desc: Artist Lachlan Goudie explores how, at the turn of the 19th century, Scotland's artists challenged the traditions they had inherited and, embracing new ways of seeing and painting from the Continent, revolutionised Scottish art. From the Glasgow Boys' intimate rural realism, to Arthur Melville's brilliantly experimental watercolours; from Hill House, Charles Rennie Mackintosh's 'total work of art', to JD Fergusson's pioneering Scottish modernism, this generation transformed the way we saw Scotland's landscape and identity.

programme.title: Classic Mastermind
programme.desc: Magnus Magnusson presents the quiz programme from Salford University. The specialist subjects are British politics 1900-1918, the operas of Gilbert and Sullivan, the Indian tribes of North America 1550-1900 and the political history of China since 1911.

programme.title: Call My Bluff
programme.desc: Panel game of word definitions and deceptions hosted by Robert Robinson. Team captains Frank Muir and Patrick Marshall are joined by guest panellists Gemma Craven, Leslie Thomas, Kate O'Mara and Brian Blessed.

programme.title: This Cultural Life
programme.desc: Singer-songwriter and composer Rufus Wainwright talks to John Wilson about his creative influences.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Mary Marquis in conversation with poets Douglas Dunn and Craig Raine.

programme.title: Metalworks!
programme.desc: In a story where progress meets invention, this film looks at how the blacksmith created items in wrought and cast iron that both served and embellished society. From the earliest ornate hinges and doors to magnificent baroque gates and mass-produced street furniture, it reveals the mastery of metalworkers. They include Jean Tijou, Robert Bakewell and John Tresilian, the designs of Robert Adam and George Gilbert Scott, and the mass marketers of the Victorian age such as the Saracen foundry. Treasures are drawn from all corners of the UK in a celebration of the best of British decorative ironwork.

programme.title: An Art Lovers' Guide
programme.desc: In the first of a series of city adventures, Janina Ramirez and Alastair Sooke head to Lisbon, rapidly becoming one of Europe’s most popular tourist destinations. Winding through the city’s cobbled streets, from its steep hills to the picturesque shoreline, the cultural riches they encounter reveal the city's fascinating history. From a spectacular monument to the maritime globetrotting of Portugal’s golden age and the work of a photographer documenting the city's large African population, they discover a complex history of former glories and a darker, slave-trading past. Their journey also uncovers the impact of 20th-century dictatorship on the city's artistic and cultural life, through the work of contemporary artists Paula Rego and Joana Vasconcelos. And they discover how the city's location on the west coast of Europe, looking out to the Atlantic, has shaped the cosmopolitan spirit of the city. In one of the city's Fado clubs, Alastair and Nina enjoy the popular Portuguese folk music, whose beautiful melodies celebrate a yearning for home, once sung by sailors dreaming of their return.

programme.desc: Fred Dibnah continues his tour of Britain's great building feats with a look at our places of work. In Chatham he visits one of our oldest dockyards, while at Armley Mills in Leeds he discovers an early form of fireproofing. programme.title: War Walks
programme.desc: 1 July 1916 was the blackest day in the British army's history. Richard Holmes walks the fields where 57,000 soldiers were killed or wounded in just a few hours, and continues the story until the end of the Somme campaign in 1916.

programme.title: To the Manor Born

programme.title: The Stuarts
programme.desc: This three-part series argues that the Stuarts, more than any other, were Britain's defining royal family. After Charles I's disastrous attempt to militarily impose political and religious uniformity throughout his kingdoms, both the Stuart dynasty and its three kingdoms fell into an abyss. Charles lost his head and his family fled into exile. In this second episode, Dr Clare Jackson reveals how the unprecedented religious violence of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms shaped the very DNA of British political culture and how the trauma suffered influenced constitutional crises in the years to come.

programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: The Last Spy - Storyville, by acclaimed film-maker Katharina Otto-Bernstein, shines a light on the extraordinary life of legendary CIA officer Peter Sichel, who died in 2024 at the age of 102. A Jewish refugee who fled Nazi Germany before becoming one of the most influential figures in American intelligence, Sichel rose to serve as the CIA's first station chief in post-war Berlin and played a pivotal role in some of the defining geopolitical events of the Cold War. Through remarkably candid interviews filmed shortly before his death, Sichel reflects on a century shaped by conflict, espionage and political upheaval, offering a rare insider's perspective on the origins of many of today's global political tensions. As one of the last living witnesses to a pivotal era of modern history, he shares his story in full for the first time in this fascinating film. Combining personal testimony with historical insight, this documentary explores the moral complexities of intelligence work and the enduring consequences of decisions made behind closed doors.

programme.title: Colour: The Spectrum of Science
programme.desc: Helen Czerski uncovers what colour is, how it works and how it has written the story of our planet. She seeks out the hues that turned the Earth multicoloured.

programme.desc: Tha tòrr spòrs aig Peicein is a charaidean a’ cur an ìre gur e ròbotan a th’ annta, gus am brùth cuideigin aca putan is tha an aileag a’ tòiseachadh air Peicein. Carson nach stad an aileag aige? Bheil smachd aig cuideigin air à àiteigin eile? Chan urrainn do Ghriogair sguir a shreothartaich, Lòra a mhèaranaich neo Raghnall a chasadaich. Saoil a bheil iad uile a’ tionndadh nan ròbotan dhà-rìribh? Petit and his friends are having a lot of fun pretending to be robots, until one of them presses a button and Petit gets the hiccups. Why can't he stop hiccupping? Is someone else controlling him from somewhere? Greg can't stop sneezing, Laura yawns and Roman coughs. Could it be that everyone is turning into real life robots?

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda a’ tionndadh gu leabhar dìomhair airson ionnsachadh mar a chuidicheas i beathannan Dhaibhidh agus a màthair – ach, mo chreach, abair gu ‘eil a coibhneis cosgail is croiseil dhaibh uile. Hilda turns to a mysterious book to learn how she can better the lives of Daibhidh and her mother, but being kind proves to be costly and problematic for all.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Nuair tha Greta an cù a’ cèilidh air an sgoil, tha Flix airson a bhith taiceil dhi. Gu mì-fhortanach tha iad glè mhì-mhodhail nuair a tha ‘ad còmhla. Tha seo ag adhbharachadh trioblaid coin-cait ach the feum air fuasgladh cait-coin. When Greta the dog visits the school, Flix wants to be helpful to her. Unfortunately, they’re very badly behaved when together. This causes a dog-cat problem so what’s needed is a cat-dog solution!

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Tha cùisean a-dol ceàrr leis na Farpaisich ach tha a’ Chrùbag faisg air làimh le cobhair, tòrr ruitheam agus an 'cha cha cha'! Things go awry with the competitors, but Crùbag is near to hand, with lots of rhythm and the 'cha cha cha'!

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc: Tha Isra cho toilichte nuair a tha i a’ faighinn an cothrom càmpadh mar a sìnnsearan - na Bedouin - còmhla ri a caraid, Laoise. Isra is delighted when she gets the chance to go camping like her ancestors, the Bedouin, with her friend, Laoise.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Seachd Là
programme.desc: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Ann am prògram às an tasglann bho 2009, Salm 31 air a sheinn le Ceathrar-cheòil Còisir Ghàidhlig Ìleach Ghlaschu, Laoidh Chalum Chille le Còisir Ghàidhlig Bhaile Ghobhainn agus bidh Torcuil MacLeòid ag innse mun phàirt a th' aig creideamh na bheatha fhèin. Air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. In an archival edition from 2009, Psalm 31 sung by the Glasgow Islay Gaelic Choir Quartet, the hymn Laoidh Chalum Chille by Govan Gaelic Choir, and Torquil MacLeod tells his personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Cidsin Granaidh Chalanais
programme.desc: Gregor makes his grannie’s gingerbread and classic Scottish tablet, and adds his own flair to her fishcake recipe.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Actress turned interior designer, Erica Macpherson, takes us on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers she finds new ideas for designing old spaces. Tha an cleasaiche, a tha a-nis na dealbhaiche cruthachail thaighean, Erica Nic a’ Phersain, a’ gabhail sgrìob tron Ghàidhealtachd ‘s na h-Eileanan. Le taic bho luchd-ciùird, tha i a’ lorg dhòighean ùra air seann rumanan a thoirt beò. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Surfing: Marcachd an Tuinn/Riding the Wave
programme.desc: Tha Ceitlin Lilidh a’ toirt thugainn sreath de dhà phàirt air eachdraidh surfadh air feadh an t-saoghail. Ceitlin Lilidh's series on the world history of surfing.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram de cheòl traidiseanta agus freumhach air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. A’ taisbeanaidh chlàraidhean is chòmhraidhean a chaidh a dhèanamh aig àm Celtic Connections 2024, chìte cuid den luchd-ciùil a b’ fheàrr a bha aig an fhèis, leithid Talisk, Julie Fowlis/Éamon Doorley/Zoë Conway/John Mc Intyre, Glen Hansard & Breanndán Ó Beaglaoich, Buffalo Nichols agus Pine Tree Flyers. Traditional and roots music show presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Filmed during Celtic Connections 2024, Seirm showcases bespoke recordings and conversations with some of the best artists appearing at the festival. This episode features performances from Talisk; Julie Fowlis, Éamon Doorley, Zoë Conway, John McIntyre; Glen Hansard & Breanndán Ó Beaglaoich, Buffalo Nichols and Pine Tree Flyers. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ciad-fàthan nan Creutairean/Wild Senses
programme.desc: We explore the surprising ways animals use touch to sense their world, find food and stay out of danger.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: An greimean lòin as fheàrr le Abigail, 's e Buntàta Cruasbach Sàiste. 'Ad cho blast' 's a tha 'ad rin ithe. Tha 'n seòrs' aice-se soirbh a dhèanamh; feumaidh tu fheuchainn. Abigail’s favourite snack lunch is crispy sage potatoes. It's as nice to look at as to eat and her version is easy to make - you must try it! In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Ladybird & Bee/Daolag-bhreac is Seillean
programme.desc: Tha Daolag-bhreac is Seillean air an dòigh glan nuair tha na duilleagan a’ cuachail gu talamh! Daolag-bhreac and Seillean are delighted when the leaves start twirling to the ground!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha seillean glacte ann an uamhag Bhernie agus, gun e air biadh fhaighinn, tha e cho fann ‘s nach dèan e a shlighe dhachaigh! Ge-tà, tha Oona ‘s Baba deònach a dhol a-lorg biadh dha gus am fàs e làidir a-rithist! There’s a bee trapped in Bernie’s grotto but without anything to eat, he has become too weak to escape and make his way back to the hive. However, Oona and Baba are on hand to find and bring him the food he needs to build his strength back up!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Mossy airson a dhol air turas-ionmhais bidhe ach ‘s ann a dh’ fheumas an sgioba dhol air misean-seilg' eadar-dhealaichte 's Pip ‘s Pop air a dhol am falach air Otto bochd! Mossy wants the gang to join him on a food hunt, but they are all called on a different sort of search when Pip and Pop decide to hide on poor Otto!

programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc: Nuair tha ruitheam a’ chiùil bhon rèidio a’ còrdadh ri Boban cho mòr ‘s gu bheil e toirt air danns', chan eil Fuigheag buileach a' tuigs' na gluasadan bodhaig a tha seo! Boban enjoys the rhythm of the music on the radio so much, that he begins to dance. But Fuigheag isn’t sure what these movements are all about!

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a’ gabhail pàirt ann an latha chleasan nan Losgann. Ziff, Pipp and Button compete in their own Froggie sports day.

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Gach oidhche bidh Comhachag a’ cumail geàrd air a’ choille. Ge-tà, leis a’ ghealach a’ sìor fhàs tana agus a’ choille a’ sìor fhàs dorcha, tha Comhachag a’ fàs aonranach. Chan eil e idir cho measail air a dhleastanas. Gu fortanach, tha plàna aig Maigheach! Every night, Owl keeps watch over the forest. But with the Moon growing thinner and the woods growing darker night by night, Owl begins to feel lonely. He starts to dread his duties. Luckily, Hare has a plan!

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Tha Mamaidh air rud dìomhair innse do Phompon - tha i air cuirm a' chur air dòigh 'son cò-là-breith Dadaidh - ach ciamar a chumas Pompon an rùn-dìomhair? Mamaidh has told Pompon a secret - she's arranged a party for Daddy's birthday. But how will Pompon keep the secret?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Gilleasbaig Fearghasdan a’ leughadh Mèirleach nan Dathan. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Gabriel Alborozo, agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Dòmhnall Iain MacLeòid. A bedtime story for young children. Gilleasbaig Ferguson reads Mèirleach nan Dathan, written and illustrated by Gabriel Alborozo and translated into Gaelic by Donald John MacLeod.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Man Ray rents Squidward's house. Tha An Sòrnan a’ gabhail taigh Ghiobaird air mhàl.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Leis mar a chaidh sgrùdadh na sgoile an-uiridh, tha bòrd na sgoile air Leas-Cheannard ùr, Ms Dallas, a thoirt a-steach gus sùil ghèir a chumail air Mgr Mackle. Bidh sinn a' coinneachadh ri tidsearean ùra agus ri feadhainn air a bheil sinn air eòlas a chuir roimhe. After last year’s school inspection, the school board has appointed a new deputy head, Ms Dallas, to keep an eye on Mr Mackle. We meet new teachers alongside some recognisable personalities.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Tha eadar-dhealaichidhean air an comharrachadh san sgoil is, mar dhùbhlain, tha aig Flix is Burma ri bhith càirdeil ri chèile. Chan eil fhios ciamar a dh'obraicheas seo a-mach ge-tà! Differences are celebrated in school and, as a challenge, Flix and Burma have to be friendly with one another. Nobody knows how this will work out though!

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Nuair tha Bonns is Uilidh a' sàbhaladh Throig bhon Bhògais-shìd’, tha e uabhasach neo-thaingeil. Cho neo-thaingeil ‘s gu bheil e a' tilleadh air ais chun na Bògaisean. Ach tha e ag ionnsachadh gu bheil caraidean feumail aig a' cheann thall! When Bonns and Uilidh save Troig from Bògais-shìd’, he is very ungrateful. So much so, that he returns to see the Bògaisean. However, he learns that friends are helpful, at the end of the day!

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Tha Uilidh airson dearbhadh gu bheil e treun – dìreach mar an Gumbal gun Ainm. Ciamar a thèid dha? Bheil e treun no bheil e dìreach gòrach? Uilidh wants to prove that he is a hero just like the Un-named Gumbal. How will he get on? Is he brave or is he just foolish?

programme.title: Fillte
programme.desc: Fillte goes on a journey throughout Scotland to discover the history and contemporary hand-crafted practice behind the artisan production of woven fabrics, such as wool, hemp, linen, grasses, leather and many more unorthodox materials. Tha Fillte a gabhail turas tro Alba a’ sireadh eachdraidh agus sgeulachdan an latha ’n diugh co-cheangailte ris an luchd-ciùird a tha snìomh ‘s ag obrachadh diofar stuthan, leithid, clòimh, corcach, anart, feur,leathar, agus iomadh seorsa stuth iongantach eile.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Calum Maclean visits Airth in Stirlingshire where he discovers a fruity architectural surprise.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Seo an fharpais-cheist far a bheil barrachd air eòlas coitcheann a dhìth gus buannachadh. Le Niall Iain Dòmnhallach aig an stiùir cluichidh na sgiobaidhean anns an stiùideo an aghaidh an ochdnar Mas Fhìoraich a tha a’ cluich bhon dachaighean fhèin agus a tha a’ cur nan ceistean. A’ strì an aghaidh na Mas Fhìoraich airson feuchainn air an duais mhòr, tha DK is Kenna agus Kirsty is Seònaid. Presented by Niall Iain MacDonald, this is the quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Playing from the comfort of their own homes are the Pretenders, and they are the ones posing the questions. Battling the Pretenders to win the big prize are DK and Kenna, and Kirsty and Janet. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Trusadh
programme.desc: Ciamar a tha fuil-mìos a’ toirt buaidh air boireannaich? How do periods affect women?

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.desc: After years of unhappiness, mill worker Mairead finally walks out of her decades-long marriage and into the arms of the person she loves - hotel owner Cairistiona. However, as the women agree to wait for the right time to tell Mairead’s husband Boyd they are together, little do they know there’s someone watching from the shadows. Às dèidh bliadhnaichean de mhì-thoileachas, tha neach-obrach na muilne, Mairead, a’ fàgail an duine aice às dèidh bliadhnaichean fada pòsta airson a bhith còmhla ris an neach air a bheil gaol aice – Cairistìona, aig a bheil an taigh-òsta. Ach, ged a tha na boireannaich agaontachadh feitheamh gus innse dha Boyd, an duine aig Mairead, gu bheil iad còmhla – ‘s beag a dh’fhios a th’ aca gu bheil cuideigin ‘san dorchadas gan coimhead. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Tha Ramsay MacMahon a’ dol air turas gus ionnsachadh mun sgaradh mòr eadar beartas agus bochdainn ann an São Paulo, Braisil. Bho na coimhearsnachdan beartach glaiste air cùl gheataichean tèarainteachd gu na favelas a tha a’ cuir thairis le sluagh, tha ballachan do-fhaicsinneach a’ sgaradh dhaoine bho chèile sa bhaile seo. Air an turas aige, cluinnidh Ramsay bho dhaoine a tha feuchainn ris an sgaradh seo a thoirt às a chèile le bhith a’ cruthachadh chothroman do dhaoine ann an cuid de na coimhearsnachdan far a bheil an ana-chothrom as motha ri fhaicinn. Ramsay MacMahon goes on a journey to find out about the deep divide between wealth and poverty in São Paulo, Brazil. From the affluent gated communities to the overcrowded favelas, invisible walls separate people in this city. On his journey, Ramsay hears from individuals who are determined to break down division by creating opportunities for people within some of the city's most disadvantaged communities. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Faodail
programme.desc: Tha Tasglann Fhilm Faodail a’ tarraing aire gu filmichean dhùthchasach Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 80an, a bha caillte ach a-nis glèidhte don ghinealach ri teachd. Tha bhana Cinema Sgìre Leantainneach a’ siubhal nan eilean, a’ taisbeanadh fhilmichean sna sgìrean ionadail, le cothrom am faicinn air-loidhne air feadh an t-saoghail. Cuirear aithris bheairteach ùr riutha, a’ buntainn ris a’ Ghàidhealtachd, airson luchd-amhairc an là an-diugh. The Faodail Film Archive celebrates lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s-1980s in the Outer Hebrides, preserving the archive for future generations. The Cinema Sgìre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands, showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gàidhealtachd for contemporary audiences. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Glan Fhèin
programme.desc: A mockumentary shadowing a company that services short-term lets. Angela and Katie aim to clean up and give the competition a bleaching. Blockages need to be dealt with, not just unclogging hot tub filters. A new staff member has a few skeletons in his cupboard, but ex-con Daniel hopes he has a squeaky clean future. Meanwhile, Betty meets Daniel’s pregnant partner Dido and checks in on her beloved pet pooch Buster. Soon, the police are knocking on the company’s Portakabin door. Written by and starring Hannah McKirdy and Lana Pheutan.

programme.desc: Tha Daolag-bhreac is Seillean air an dòigh glan nuair tha na duilleagan a’ cuachail gu talamh! Daolag-bhreac and Seillean are delighted when the leaves start twirling to the ground!

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: ‘S e latha ciùin a th’ ann, ach tha Nìp a’ cladhach thuill air feadh an eilein, is cha stad e. Tha Àtaidh is Tilidh a’ feuchainn ri obrachadh a-mach gu dè tha ga fhàgail air bhioran mar seo. Feumaidh gur e a cho-là-breith a th’ ann! It is a peaceful day but Neep is digging holes all over the Island and won’t stop. Abney and Teal try to work out why he is so excited. It must be his birthday!

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Stan spots a swift and spies a mystery - why don't they ever land? Grace acts as air-traffic control and Stan and Gran take to the skies. Tha Dan a' faicinn gòbhlan-mòr agus rùn-dìomhair – carson nach tig 'ad gu talamh? Tha Ceit mar neach-obrach bhon tùr-stiùiridh, agus tha Dan is Gran a' dèanamh air na sgòthan.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Mòrag Anna NicNèill a’ leughadh Air a’ Chladach. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Anna Milbourne agus a dhealbhachadh le Erica-Jane Waters. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Dòmhnall Iain MacLeòid. A bedtime story for young children. Morag Ann MacNeil reads Air a’ Chladach by Anna Milbourne, illustrated by Erica-Jane Waters and translated into Gaelic by Donald John MacLeod.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda, Flòraidh is Daibhidh a’ feuchainn ri bràistean Sgùdan Sporais às ùr a chosnadh. Air sgàth sin, tha 'ad dol a’ shireadh planntraisean annasach ionadail – agus abair g’ eil sin na chuairt-dànachd glè inntinneach. Hilda, Flòraidh and Daibhidh are trying to earn new Sgùdan Sporrais badges. They go in search of rare, local plants, and this turns into a very interesting adventure.

programme.title: Stri
programme.desc: Tha preasantairean CBBC ALBA uabhasach fhèin measail air dùbhlain ach saoil cò shoirbhicheas is Shanni a’ tadhal orra? The CBBC ALBA presenters love a good challenge, but who will emerge victorious as Shanni joins them?

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Mar ‘s àbhaist, tha Coinneach Clogaid a’ feuchainn ri casg a chur air a h-uile Farpaiseach eile. Na can rium gu bheil e dol a bhuannachadh an trup-sa, ge-tà? ‘S cinnteach nach eil? As ever, Coinneach Clogaid is trying to stop all the other competitors. Don’t tell me he’s going to win this time though. Surely not?

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc: Tha Lena na nighean òg Roma agus, ged nach eil e àbhaisteach sa chultar aic’, ’s e a miann a bhith na ballerina. A dh’aindeoin a h-uile cnap-starra, tha i treun gu soirbheachadh. Lena is a young Roma girl and, even though it's not normal practice in her culture, she dreams of being a ballerina. Despite all the obstacles, she is determined to succeed.

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Abair gu bheil maorach a’ còrdadh ri na seòid agus anns a’ phrògram-sa, tha iad a’ còcaireachd le crùbag, rud air a bheilear tric a’ dèanamh dearmaid. Tha Ùisdean ag ullachadh ciad cùrsa dathte a’ cleachdadh feòil chrùbaig dhonn agus deiseag. Tha Ruairidh a’ dèanamh Linguine Crùbaig fhad ’s a tha Ùisdean cuideachd a’ dèanamh pasta, Ravioli air a lìonadh le feòil crùbaig agus bisque crùbaig. Aig deireadh gnothaich, tha Ruairidh a’ cruthachadh biadh sònraichte, spring rolls crùbaig teth is fuar. The lads love seafood, and the often overlooked and underrated crab features in this episode. Uisdean prepares a colourful crab starter using brown and velvet crab meat. Ruaridh makes an interesting crab linguini while Uisdean continues the pasta thread by making ravioli filled with crab meat and a crab bisque. To finish, Ruaridh creates a speciality, hot and cold crab spring rolls. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she introduces words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work and communication. We meet diligent learners who have embraced speaking Gaelic, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. And, the intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland. Supporting materials can be found online at www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.desc: Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Iseabail NicAsgailll. Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee with guest Ishbel MacAskill. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Ann am prògram às an tasglann bho 2009, Salm 31 air a sheinn le Ceathrar-cheòil Còisir Ghàidhlig Ìleach Ghlaschu, Laoidh Chalum Chille le Còisir Ghàidhlig Bhaile Ghobhainn agus bidh Torcuil MacLeòid ag innse mun phàirt a th' aig creideamh na bheatha fhèin. Air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. In an archival edition from 2009, Psalm 31 sung by the Glasgow Islay Gaelic Choir Quartet, the hymn Laoidh Chalum Chille by Govan Gaelic Choir, and Torquil MacLeod tells his personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Stan spots a swift and spies a mystery - why don't they ever land? Grace acts as air-traffic control and Stan and Gran take to the skies. Tha Dan a' faicinn gòbhlan-mòr agus rùn-dìomhair – carson nach tig 'ad gu talamh? Tha Ceit mar neach-obrach bhon tùr-stiùiridh, agus tha Dan is Gran a' dèanamh air na sgòthan.

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a’ gabhail pàirt ann an latha chleasan nan Losgann. Ziff, Pipp and Button compete in their own Froggie sports day.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha am Màidsear air fear de na h-innleachdan feumail aige a chruthachadh, ach chan eil còir aig duine beantainn ris fhad 's a tha e air falbh. Bu mhòr am beud nach do dh'èist Beag ris. Major has come up with one of his useful inventions, but no-one is allowed to touch it while he is away. It’s a shame that Beag didn’t listen to him.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha na Clangairean airson latha sònraichte a thoirt do Dhràgon Brot air sgàth ‘s gu bheil i cho fialaidh ‘s còir. Tha min dòchas gun obraich seo a-mach math dhaibh. The Clangers would like to organise a special day for Soup Dragon as she is so kind and generous. Hopefully this works out well for them.

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein is Lòra ag argamaid mu dheidhinn cò aca a bu chòir na riaghailtean a dhèanamh suas airson geama Ghriogair is Raghnaill. Fhad ’s a tha iadsan a’ feuchainn ri obrachadh a-mach cò aca a bu chòir a bhith nan sgiobair, tha Griogair agus Raghnall a’ cumail a’ cluich às aonais a’ bhuill. Petit and Laura argue about who should be the one that makes the rules of Greg and Roman's game. While they decide who should be the captain, Greg and Roman wait for them to make a decision and continue playing without the ball.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Iain MacAonghais a’ leughadh Caiptean Wag agus na Mathain Bhàna. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Michael Terry agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Mòrag Stiùbhart. A bedtime story for young children. Iain MacInnes reads Caiptean Wag agus na Mathain Bhàna, written and illustrated by Michael Terry and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Tha rèis dhan bhàrr dol bhith ann – a’ chiad oileanach a chuireas flaga air Beinn Rocaid a' buinnig na duais. Ach bheil cuideigin na chealgaire? A race to the summit is going to take place - the first student to plant a flag on Mount Rocket will win the trophy. But is somebody a cheat?

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Tha mòran ri innse an-diugh – mar a theich Sebastian ri Linn burraidheachd Chamshron, is tha sinn cuideachd ’g ionnsachadh mun chiad choinneachadh le Belle. There’s much to tell today - how Sebastian decided to run away as a result of Cameron’s bullying, and we learn about his first meeting with Belle.

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha Bitzer air crìoch a chuir air an obair-taighe gu lèir agus a-nis chan eil càil aige ri dhèanamh. The e air a dhòigh nuair a mhothachas e gu bheil an t-sabhal feumach air sgioblachadh - gus an tig e tairsinn air dealbh nach gabh a chrochadh gu dìreach! Bitzer has completed all his chores and is at a bit of a loss. He's delighted when he discovers the flock's barn needs a good tidy-up, until he comes across a wonky picture that just won't hang straight.

programme.title: Alba Eagalach
programme.desc: Tha sgioba CBBC ALBA a’ toirt thugainn cuid de na sgeulachdan agus na tachartasan as eagalaiche ann an eachdraidh na h-Alba. Anns a’ phrògram seo, coinnichidh sinn ri Uilleam Uallas agus cluinnidh sinn mun bheatha eagalach a bh’ aige ach chan eil e fhèin ro dheònach bruidhinn mu dheidhinn! CBBC ALBA brings us some of the scariest stories from Scottish history. In this episode, we meet William Wallace and uncover the grisly details of his life. Surprisingly, he doesn't seem too keen to talk about these!

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Tha eadar-dhealaichidhean air an comharrachadh san sgoil is, mar dhùbhlain, tha aig Flix is Burma ri bhith càirdeil ri chèile. Chan eil fhios ciamar a dh'obraicheas seo a-mach ge-tà! Differences are celebrated in school and, as a challenge, Flix and Burma have to be friendly with one another. Nobody knows how this will work out though!

programme.title: Fillte
programme.desc: Fillte goes on a journey throughout Scotland to discover the history and contemporary hand-crafted practice behind the artisan production of woven fabrics, such as wool, hemp, linen, grasses, leather and many more unorthodox materials. Tha Fillte a gabhail turas tro Alba a’ sireadh eachdraidh agus sgeulachdan an latha ’n diugh co-cheangailte ris an luchd-ciùird a tha snìomh ‘s ag obrachadh diofar stuthan, leithid, clòimh, corcach, anart, feur,leathar, agus iomadh seorsa stuth iongantach eile.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Sara Robertson is Joy’s guest in the studio and chats about her unusual home, while Calum Maclean is on Great Bernera, trying to a find an unusual historic property.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay MacMahon meets well-known Gaels across Scotland to share stories, appreciate nature and reflect on their lives. Ramsay walks with Coinneach Rankin in Lochalsh, the area where he grew up and still calls home. San treas sreath de Rathad Ramsay bidh Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri sàr Ghàidheil bho air feadh Alba ‘s iad a’ co-roinn sgeulachdan, cuir luach air nàdar agus a’ cnuasachadh ma beatha. Tha Ramsay a’ coinneachadh ri Coinneach MacFhraing ann an Loch Aillse, an t-àite far an do thogar e agus ris an abair e fhathast a dhachaigh. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Tha Ramsay MacMahon ag ionnsachadh mu bheatha air a’ chrìoch eadar an Fhionnlainn agus an Ruis. Bho thug an Ruis ionnsaigh air an Ucràin ann an 2022 tha a’ chrìoch air dùnadh gu tur, ag atharrachadh beatha dhaoine air gach taobh. Anns an Fhionnlainn, cluinnidh Ramsay sgeulachdan bho theaghlaichean a chaidh a’ sgaradh bho an luchd-gràdh air taobh eile na crìche. Coinnichidh e riuthsan air a bheil an dleastanas ‘son tèarainteachd aig a’ chrìoch agus cluinnidh e bho dhaoine a chaill am beòshlaint’ gu h-obann air sgàth an dùnaidh. Ramsay MacMahon learns about life along the border between Finland and Russia. Since Russia’s attack on Ukraine in 2022 the border has closed completely, transforming the lives of people on both sides. In Finland, Ramsay hears the stories of families who have been separated from their loved ones on the other side, meets those responsible for securing the border and hears from people who have lost their livelihood overnight because of its closure. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Faodail
programme.desc: Tha Tasglann Fhilm Faodail a’ tarraing aire gu filmichean dhùthchasach Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 80an, a bha caillte ach a-nis glèidhte don ghinealach ri teachd. Tha bhana Cinema Sgìre Leantainneach a’ siubhal nan eilean, a’ taisbeanadh fhilmichean sna sgìrean ionadail, le cothrom am faicinn air-loidhne air feadh an t-saoghail. Cuirear aithris bheairteach ùr riutha, a’ buntainn ris a’ Ghàidhealtachd, airson luchd-amhairc an là an-diugh. The Faodail Film Archive celebrates lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s-1980s in the Outer Hebrides, preserving the archive for future generations. The Cinema Sgìre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands, showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gàidhealtachd for contemporary audiences. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: A’ sireadh Dànachd anns an Roinn Eòrpa, tha Coinneach MacFhraing a’ siubhal gu dùthaich nam beann iongantach – Nirribhidh. Còmhla ri a chompanach sreap, Calum Gibb, bidh Coinneach a’ dìreadh ‘Stetind’, stùc le eachdraidh bheairteach a tha air mac-meanmna luchd-sreap a ghlacadh airson còrr is ceud bliadhna. Seeking adventure on a grand scale in Europe, Coinneach Rankin travels to the mountain paradise of Norway. Along with his climbing partner, Calum Gibb, Coinneach makes an ascent of Stetind, a peak with a storied past that has captured the imagination of mountaineers for well over a century. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Obair sgioba an Aonad Dlùth-chùram Leanabain ’s iad a’ coimhead an dèidh naoidheanan so-leònta. The work of the NICU team and their care for vulnerable babies.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Tha sgioba bata teasairginn Fraochy Bay a' dol a-sas ann an trèanadh agus a sùil ri de na dh'fhaodadh tighinn le blàthachadh na cruinne. Tha am bàrd Torcuil Fearchar deònach cobhair a dhèanamh oirre ach co a nith cobhair aire-san? The Fraochy Bay lifeboat crew are having a training day. The scenario involves an icy adventure. Passing poet Torquil Farquhar is roped in to help and is well-versed in his role, but what about the lifeboat crew?

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: Roghainn bho oidhche mhòr duaisean Na Trads 2022. A nochd ceòl bho St Roch’s & Tayside Young Fiddlers. Highlights from the Trad Awards 2022 with music from St Roch’s and Tayside Young Fiddlers.

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.desc: After years of unhappiness, mill worker Mairead finally walks out of her decades-long marriage and into the arms of the person she loves - hotel owner Cairistiona. However, as the women agree to wait for the right time to tell Mairead’s husband Boyd they are together, little do they know there’s someone watching from the shadows. Às dèidh bliadhnaichean de mhì-thoileachas, tha neach-obrach na muilne, Mairead, a’ fàgail an duine aice às dèidh bliadhnaichean fada pòsta airson a bhith còmhla ris an neach air a bheil gaol aice – Cairistìona, aig a bheil an taigh-òsta. Ach, ged a tha na boireannaich agaontachadh feitheamh gus innse dha Boyd, an duine aig Mairead, gu bheil iad còmhla – ‘s beag a dh’fhios a th’ aca gu bheil cuideigin ‘san dorchadas gan coimhead. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Arts in Motion
programme.desc: Arts in Motion reveals the creative lives and working habits of extraordinary artists. Architect Lina Ghotmeh builds from her philosophy 'archaeology of the future'. From the chiselled facades of Beirut's Stone Garden to sustainable wooden pavilions, her work blends artistry, craft and care for the planet. Now, she's embarking on the redesign of the Western Range of the British Museum.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: The AI industry has just had the fright of its life. After a shock US midterm election result handed Democrats control of both houses of Congress, the companies leading the AI revolution suddenly face an uncomfortable reality: investigations, subpoenas, public backlash and the prospect of sweeping new regulation. At the very centre of the storm is Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, whose company sits at the heart of the global AI boom. Recent revelations surrounding Huang have triggered a crisis of confidence, wiped hundreds of billions from Nvidia's market value, and raised difficult questions about corporate governance, national security and the concentration of power inside the AI industry. Meanwhile, Elon Musk's political gamble appears to have backfired spectacularly. After pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into the midterms, Silicon Valley's most influential figures are now confronting a Congress that may be far less willing to give them the benefit of the doubt.

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. In this episode: Akisa Wandera reports from Angola, where billions of dollars are being poured into a vast new trade corridor at the centre of a global race for critical minerals. We examine what's at stake for the people living on the frontline of this transformation. Plus: BBC Brasil travels to the city of Camaçari, where Chinese carmaker BYD has opened its biggest factory in Latin America. As Chinese investment reshapes jobs, industry and daily life, we explore how one Brazilian city has become a test case for the growing rivalry between China and the United States.

programme.title: Clive Myrie's African Adventure
programme.desc: Clive travels inland from the hustle and bustle of Lagos to Abeokuta. He gets his shorts on to test his basketball skills on the court with an inspirational coach, before getting suited and booted to attend the birthday celebrations of a local gospel singer and see just how Nigerians throw a party. He also gets hands-on to create authentic tie-and-dye adire clothes and joins in with an incredible contemporary dance troupe.

programme.title: Talking Business

With billions on the line, will holidaymakers choose new destinations and new times to travel? We speak to the climate lead at Intrepid Travel and the boss of Scandinavia's largest ski operator. Also, we find out what a record hot summer could mean for the UK's wine industry.

She comes face to face with the cuddly, but powerful capybaras in São Paulo's public parks, and meets the puma family who've become stars in the local community.

programme.title: The Big Cases
programme.desc: In one of the biggest UK celebrity trials, Russell Brand is jailed after being found guilty of rape and sexual assaults. This is the story of how the actor, once one of the biggest faces on TV, ended up disgraced. This film hears from the police, a former friend and an investigative journalist behind the original expose on Brand. The BBC’s Helena Wilkinson who attended the trial reports. If you or someone you know has been affected by any of the issues raised in this story, information and support is available at BBC Action Line.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: It's been a week of great consequence for the media. On Monday, Russell Brand was sentenced to over ten years in prison for rape and sexual assault. On Tuesday - in a separate story - ITV News and The Guardian named David Walliams as the celebrity who tried to use an injunction to block the publication of sexual misconduct allegations. Our panel discusses the issues raised: Rosamund Urwin, chief news correspondent at The Sunday Times; Alex Wilson, partner at RPC, and Sarah Ditum, author of Toxic: Women, Fame and The Noughties.

programme.title: The Interface
programme.desc: A wave of fridge and freezer hacks in Europe could be a sign of something much bigger. Thomas Germain and Jessica Maddox ask whether we're heading for a 'hackpocalypse', a world where AI helps almost anyone find and exploit old security flaws. Plus, Google says that US schools can now switch off AI on student Chromebooks, but if they do, kids will lose access to Google Search. Google says the two are now too closely linked to separate - and the changes give schools more choice. Tom and Jess dig into why it's a controversial move, what it says about Google's grip on American schools, and what it could mean for Big Tech at a time when the public is losing patience with AI.

Aks is drawn in by the prospect of internet fame, while Mobeen tries to see if the spark between him and Aks’s teacher, Miss Aitken, is worth pursuing. programme.desc: After landing a huge sale at his new job, Jub goes for a big night out with his colleagues but finds himself struggling to match their pace. Meanwhile, Basil is starting to miss Jub.

programme.title: Strike

programme.title: Killing Eve
programme.desc: Carolyn brings unwelcome news about Nadia, and a change of priorities, but Eve is closer than she's ever been to Villanelle and is finally going to meet Anna. Why would she give up the hunt now? Kenny has some revelations that make Eve question the true purpose of their entire mission. Meanwhile, Villanelle is still in prison, now in solitary confinement, waiting for the rescue organised by Konstantin that never seems to come.

programme.title: Killing Eve
programme.desc: Villanelle is still on the run, but she has a hostage and she has a plan. Eve, Carolyn and Kenny are still in Russia, but old secrets coming to light have led to tension in the group. Can Eve finally get to Villanelle before the whole operation comes crashing down around them?

programme.title: Teen Predator/Online Killer
programme.desc: Twenty-year-old Alexander McCartney, already known to police, is arrested and his devices seized after a 12-year-old girl in Scotland reports a serious catfishing abuse incident online. McCartney gives a ‘no comment’ interview while in custody, and without enough physical evidence to charge him, he is released on bail. Back home at his parents’ house, McCartney’s bail conditions are supposed to prevent him from using devices that can connect to the internet. Meanwhile, a second report comes in to the police about another catfishing abuse victim linked to online activity from McCartney’s home address. This time, it involves a young girl in New Zealand. As the police continue to gather up enough physical evidence to charge McCartney, the Cyber Crime Centre completes the analysis of one of his devices, revealing a prolific online predator at a scale never before seen by police in Northern Ireland.

programme.title: Teen Predator/Online Killer
programme.desc: With hundreds of thousands of images of child abuse discovered on McCartney’s devices, the race is on to get him remanded into custody. McCartney is rearrested in the early hours of the morning, at which time police discover McCartney’s phone on his bedside table, where his final victim was abused on Snapchat just hours before. The US Department of Homeland Security notify the police in Northern Ireland of two more catfishing victims, this time in the United States, and a multiagency international investigation is triggered. As McCartney is remanded into custody, police across the world work together to identify and safeguard the thousands of victims discovered on McCartney’s devices. Police are especially keen to identify and locate a 14-year-old girl in Oregon, whose images McCartney used to catfish hundreds of other children. With McCartney due in court to plead guilty to charges of making indecent of images of children and blackmail, the case takes a different turn when Homeland Security finds an obituary page for Cimarron Thomas, one of his victims in West Virginia.

programme.title: Teen Predator/Online Killer
programme.desc: As police piece together the last few minutes of Cimarron’s life, they realise McCartney was still online threatening her when she tragically shot herself. Police and prosecutors move quickly to establish if there’s a case for manslaughter. Police from Northern Ireland travel to West Virginia to conduct the manslaughter investigation, where they learn that Cimarron’s own family had no idea why she took her own life. In a tragic turn, they learn that 18 months after her death, Cimarron’s father had also died by suicide. In order to charge McCartney with manslaughter, the police have to prove that he foresaw the risk to her life. As they comb through the cyber evidence from his devices, they build a case for manslaughter and charge him. The case sets new legal precedent in the UK. More than five years after the police investigation began, McCartney is finally convicted and sentenced.

programme.title: Sort Your Life Out
programme.desc: Stacey and her team tackle the memory-filled home of the Appleyards, a lively family of six with triplet boys.

programme.title: BBC New Comedy Awards

programme.title: BBC New Comedy Awards

programme.title: Doctor Who (2005–2022)
programme.desc: On the planet of Ranskoor Av Kolos lie the remains of a brutal battlefield. But as the Doctor, Graham, Yaz and Ryan answer nine separate distress calls, they discover the planet holds far more secrets. Who is the mysterious commander with no memory? What lies beyond the mists? Who or what are the Ux? The answers will lead the Doctor and her friends towards a deadly reckoning.

programme.title: Doctor Who (2005–2022)
programme.desc: As the new year begins, a terrifying evil from across the centuries of Earth's history is stirring. As the Doctor, Ryan, Graham and Yaz return home, will they be able to overcome the threat to planet Earth?

programme.title: UEFA Nations League
programme.desc: Stephen Watson brings you all the action live from the Puskás Aréna in Budapest as Northern Ireland conclude their UEFA Nations League campaign against Hungary. Michael O'Neill's side travel to the Hungarian capital for their final Group B2 fixture after an impressive Nations League campaign. Can they deliver a strong performance against Hungary in their final test on the road? Commentary comes from Thomas Kane and Jim Magilton, while Stuart Dallas, Caragh Hamilton and Chris Brunt are pitchside with expert analysis.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson travels to Belfast to conduct an extremely thorough test of the Renaultsport Twingo 133 involving a tunnel, a ferry and the actor Ross Kemp. Meanwhile, Richard Hammond investigates ways to speed up your next summer holiday through the crucible of motorsport as he invents the brand new sport of airport vehicle racing. At the other end of the intellectual spectrum, James May tests the new Vauxhall Insignia VXR in the company of Margaret Calvert, the lady responsible for inspired design philosophy behind the familiar British road sign. Finally, Jeremy is on and off the track in the BMW X5M, Audi Q7 V12 and the latest version of the supercharged Range Rover. The Star in the Reasonable Priced Car is the award-winning British film director Guy Ritchie.

programme.title: Teen Predator/Online Killer
programme.desc: Twenty-year-old Alexander McCartney, already known to police, is arrested and his devices seized after a 12-year-old girl in Scotland reports a serious catfishing abuse incident online. McCartney gives a ‘no comment’ interview while in custody, and without enough physical evidence to charge him, he is released on bail. Back home at his parents’ house, McCartney’s bail conditions are supposed to prevent him from using devices that can connect to the internet. Meanwhile, a second report comes in to the police about another catfishing abuse victim linked to online activity from McCartney’s home address. This time, it involves a young girl in New Zealand. As the police continue to gather up enough physical evidence to charge McCartney, the Cyber Crime Centre completes the analysis of one of his devices, revealing a prolific online predator at a scale never before seen by police in Northern Ireland.

programme.title: Teen Predator/Online Killer
programme.desc: With hundreds of thousands of images of child abuse discovered on McCartney’s devices, the race is on to get him remanded into custody. McCartney is rearrested in the early hours of the morning, at which time police discover McCartney’s phone on his bedside table, where his final victim was abused on Snapchat just hours before. The US Department of Homeland Security notify the police in Northern Ireland of two more catfishing victims, this time in the United States, and a multiagency international investigation is triggered. As McCartney is remanded into custody, police across the world work together to identify and safeguard the thousands of victims discovered on McCartney’s devices. Police are especially keen to identify and locate a 14-year-old girl in Oregon, whose images McCartney used to catfish hundreds of other children. With McCartney due in court to plead guilty to charges of making indecent of images of children and blackmail, the case takes a different turn when Homeland Security finds an obituary page for Cimarron Thomas, one of his victims in West Virginia.

programme.title: Teen Predator/Online Killer
programme.desc: As police piece together the last few minutes of Cimarron’s life, they realise McCartney was still online threatening her when she tragically shot herself. Police and prosecutors move quickly to establish if there’s a case for manslaughter. Police from Northern Ireland travel to West Virginia to conduct the manslaughter investigation, where they learn that Cimarron’s own family had no idea why she took her own life. In a tragic turn, they learn that 18 months after her death, Cimarron’s father had also died by suicide. In order to charge McCartney with manslaughter, the police have to prove that he foresaw the risk to her life. As they comb through the cyber evidence from his devices, they build a case for manslaughter and charge him. The case sets new legal precedent in the UK. More than five years after the police investigation began, McCartney is finally convicted and sentenced.

programme.desc: James Blake joins three young men to explore why they’ve turned to the so-called manosphere to achieve success, and how it’s influenced their real lives.
